about.title: About me
about.headline: Software engineering with measurable business impact.
about.description:
I’m a Software Engineer working across the full stack, with 2+ years of experience building enterprise digital products for GM, Mastercard, Leroy Merlin, LATAM Airlines, Stellantis, L’Oréal and Diageo. At MRM McCann Worldgroup, I deliver high-performance platforms in agile squads and currently build Lens Analytics, an internal generative AI product powered by AWS Bedrock that turns hours of manual reporting into insights delivered in seconds.

My experience includes campaigns for The Town, Lollapalooza Brasil and Rock in Rio, plus government-scale AEM platforms for PRODESP. I’m now specializing in AI-powered products and backend architecture with Java, Spring Boot and Docker through FIAP’s postgraduate program and hands-on work with AWS Bedrock and Claude API.
